# Priors

```{r}
#| label: priors
priors
```

```{r}
#| label: prior-fits
#| results: false
prior_fits <- setNames(lapply(specs$model, fit_prior), specs$model)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-prior-pc
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive checks: observed log sales (dark) and 50 prior predictive draws."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
wrap_plots(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  pp_check(prior_fits[[m]], ndraws = 50) + labs(title = m)
}), ncol = 2) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```
